records.text: Candace Owens said she believed the Justin Baldoni dispute was an attempted hostile takeover of his movie rights carried out through Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: when I read the lawsuit and I realized they were trying to stage a hostile takeover of the rights to his movie. ... And they sent out Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively to go and get it.

verification.notes: The hostile-takeover description came from Baldoni's allegations. A federal court dismissed his extortion theory and held that the alleged effort to take creative control did not constitute extortion; the record does not establish the claim as fact.

sources.title: Judge dismisses Justin Baldoni's $400M lawsuit against Blake Lively
sources.relevance: Reports the court's rejection of Baldoni's extortion theory and explains that alleged creative-control conduct did not constitute extortion.

sources.title: Lively v. Wayfarer Studios LLC — judgment
sources.relevance: Court record states Baldoni acquired the film rights and records the disposition of the competing legal claims.

records.text: Owens accused Blake Lively and Ryan Reynolds of deciding they were entitled to take Justin Baldoni’s movie from him.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And what happens next? They just decide that they want to take his movie, that it's their right to have it because they are them and they're shinier and or something, A-listier or something.

records.text: Owens said Ryan Reynolds reshot Deadpool scenes to include a character that was supposed to represent Justin Baldoni, called Nice Pool, who was repeatedly shot and whose head exploded.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I also was reflecting with my team on Ryan Reynolds reshooting scenes of Deadpool, incorporating a character that was supposed to be Justin Baldoni called Nice Pool, and then having him overkilled in the scene. Remember, they poured hundreds of bullets into his back, and it just kept going and going, and then the character's head explodes. Totally crazy and, again, just full-blown A-list power.

records.text: Justin Baldoni told Owens that he had never watched the Deadpool movie or the Nice Pool scene.
records.speaker: Justin Baldoni

appearances.snippet: was just being motivated by wanting to see a wrong corrected and I had mentioned to him how disturbed I was by the Deadpool scene and he told me he never even watched the Deadpool movie or the scene which makes sense because when you're in that sort of a mode and like in a survival mode you're not going to do that you're not going to like engage in things that are just going to be even worse and we just discussed how much he learned and how much he grew and how much he challenged himself.
